_about: Bestiary: kill mastery, wording for enemy targeting, and the ordered rules that generate "How to prepare" tips.

targetText.enemy_highest_threat: the hero with the most threat (your tank, if it holds aggro)
targetText.enemy_lowest_hp: the hero with the least health
targetText.enemy_highest_hp: the hero with the most health

tips.text: Heals its allies — kill it first. Use the "Specific enemy type" target on burst abilities to focus it.
Regenerates when hurt — save burst damage so it can't out-heal you.
Applies {statuses} — a Cleric with Purify (cleanse) removes these.
Curse halves healing received — cleanse it quickly, or bring shields (Barrier) instead of relying on heals.
Stuns heroes — healers with heal-over-time (Renew) or shields keep the party alive while someone is stunned.
Deals damage to the whole party — group healing (Prayer of Healing, Renew) and high Vitality help.
Has a huge single-target hit — keep your tank's defensive cooldown (Shield Wall/Evasion) ready, e.g. "when my health is below 60%".
Picks on wounded heroes — top up low-health party members early.
Attacks with magic — armor only partly reduces magical damage, so healing matters more than defense.
Frostbite slows attack speed — attack-speed gear and buffs help make up for it.
Summons adds during the fight — area damage (Cleave, Volley, Flame Wave) clears them fast.
Becomes almost immune for a few seconds (Stone Skin) — use that window for defensive and healing abilities, not burst.
Enrages{enrageAfter} — bring enough damage to finish before then.
Frenzies at low health (+15% damage) — burst it down from 60%.
Elite: much tougher than normal enemies and more likely to drop uniques and set items.

noTipsText: No special mechanics — a straightforward fight.
